# Feature name

> Status: Planned / Contract pending / Baseline implemented / Implemented
>
> Owner: team or person
>
> Linear: MET-XX
>
> First version: x.y.z

## User outcome

State the observable result for an enterprise employee.

## Scope

List what the feature owns.

## Non-goals

List what is intentionally outside this feature or version.

## Authority and tenancy

Name the authoritative data source, tenant keys, ownership, visibility and authorization boundary.

## Data model

List records and immutable/versioned objects.

## API and events

List routes, commands, emitted events, errors, idempotency and compatibility behavior.

## Security and privacy

Document allow/deny behavior, secrets, host paths, logging and isolation.

## Failure and recovery

Document timeouts, retries, deletion, replay, backup and restoration.

## Acceptance criteria

Include positive behavior, cross-user denial, restart/recovery and audit evidence.

## Open questions

Keep unresolved decisions explicit and link the owning Linear issue.
